visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #D4D4D8, or 2px solid #09090B for active/focus states. Hard lines, no soft fades.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Neo-Brutalist / Flat design. Use hard shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#09090B]) for buttons and active cards to emphasize interaction.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm (2px) to match the clinical/professional Swiss style. Avoid fully rounded pill buttons.

layouts.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-12 for grids.
layouts.grid: Bento-style for results. Image preview takes col-span-12 md:col-span-8, findings list takes col-span-12 md:col-span-4.

components.Header: Sticky at top, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90, border-b border-zinc-200. Clear logo left, Nav links center, primary CTA right.
components.UploadZone: Large flex container. dashed border-2 border-zinc-300 hover:border-primary hover:bg-blue-50/50 transition-colors. Include visual icons for Drag & Drop, Camera, File Browse.
components.ImagePreview: Relative container with overflow-hidden. Overlays should be absolute, mapped by percentages (top, left). Pins are small circular buttons with icons or numbers, contrasting heavily with the image.
components.FindingsCard: Flat, 1px border. Left color-coded bar (Red/Yellow/Green) indicating severity. Large typography for category, smaller for description.
components.Button: Sharp corners. Primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover hover:translate-y-[-2px] transition-transform. Secondary: bg-white text-zinc-950 border-2 border-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-100.

motion.hover_states: Quick transitions (duration-200). Elements lift up slightly and gain hard shadow.
motion.loading: A technical 'scanning' animation: a primary colored line moving top-to-bottom over the uploaded image with a translucent colored overlay trailing it.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to WCAG AAA. Avoid all light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels on all image markers, icon buttons, and file inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: The codebase uses .js/.jsx files. Provide all implementations in .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx.
Install react-dropzone for the drag-and-drop file upload feature.
Install react-webcam for the camera capture feature.
Install lucide-react if Shadcn requires it, but prefer Phosphor for primary app icons.
Use Shadcn UI components for Cards, Buttons, and Tooltips, adjusting them to have square corners (rounded-none).

For the Image Results view, display the image in a container with 'position: relative'. Map the JSON response (which should contain x,y coordinates) to render absolute positioned marker components (pins) over the image.
Make sure the application is a Single Page Application using React Router (Home, About Us).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone').
Mock the backend API call: simulate a 2-second delay and return a hardcoded JSON of accessibility points containing { id, x, y, severity, category, description }.
For overlays: Never use a completely transparent background under content. Use solid colors or heavy glassmorphism.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize depth, use 12-24px backdrop blur for overlays. Avoid 'AI slop' centering; left-align text blocks. Never apply 'transition: all'. Buttons must have interaction animations. Do not use AI emojis. Ensure high contrast for all UI text.
